programIndicators.name: eCBS Onset-to-Detection Lag (Hours)
programIndicators.description: CAVEAT: d2:daysBetween() casts both operands to DATE, dropping time-of-day - this is accurate to whole-day x24 buckets, not true sub-day hours. For real hour-level precision use sql/one_health_correlation.sql's sibling timeliness view or the Python pipeline instead.

programIndicators.name: eCBS Detection-to-Report Lag (Hours)
programIndicators.description: Report date = V{event_date} (the tracker event's own capture date). Same day-truncation caveat as eCBS_Onset_Detect_Hrs.

programIndicators.name: eCBS Report-to-Verification Lag (Hours)
programIndicators.description: Coalesces Actual Date of signal verification (UyCw21lYDvp) first, falling back to the planned Date of signal verification (yNqYuOn39et) only if the actual date was never captured. Same day-truncation caveat.

programIndicators.name: eCBS Pct Signals Exceeding 48h Verification SLA
programIndicators.description: Per-event value is 100 (breach) or 0 (within SLA); AVERAGE aggregation turns that directly into a percentage. Only counts signals that actually completed verification (Confirmed or Discarded) - open/pending signals are excluded, not counted as compliant. DATA QUALITY CAVEAT: this DHIS2 instance has inconsistent casing/trailing whitespace on the Signal Verification Outcome option (e.g. 'Confirmed ' with a trailing space) - see the same issue documented in scripts/monitor_open_signals.py. Program indicator expressions have no trim()/lower() function, so this filter will undercount until the option values are cleaned at the source in the DHIS2 Maintenance app.

programIndicators.name: eCBS Confirmed Signal Count
programIndicators.description: Standard DHIS2 idiom for an EVENT-analyticsType count: constant expression '1' + aggregationType COUNT means each matching event contributes exactly 1 to the sum. GEOGRAPHY CAVEAT: aggregation is keyed on the event's assigned organisationUnit (the reporting facility/org unit foreign key), NOT the free-text 'Impuruza_Sector' data element (sMlRS2gjIgc) - that field is unstructured text and isn't part of the org-unit hierarchy join, so it cannot be used as a Pivot/GIS geography dimension. Verify the event's registered organisationUnit reflects the actual event location (not just the reporting facility's catchment) before treating sector-level output as true hotspot geography.

programIndicators.name: eCBS Total Reported Signal Count
programIndicators.description: Denominator/context indicator for density and yield views - counts every captured signal event regardless of verification status. Same geography caveat as eCBS_Confirmed_Cnt.

programIndicators.name: eCBS Verified Total Signal Count
programIndicators.description: Denominator for Channel Confirmation Yield - signals that finished verification (Confirmed or Discarded), excluding signals still open/pending. Same casing/whitespace data-quality caveat as eCBS_Over48h_Verify.

indicators.name: eCBS Channel Confirmation Yield (%)
indicators.description: % of verification-complete signals that were Confirmed, i.e. numerator/denominator = eCBS_Confirmed_Cnt / eCBS_Verified_Tot_Cnt. Break down 'by EBS Type / Source' at QUERY TIME by adding the Impuruza_EBS Type data element (AXUtIJGHw0H.OEVkQ1ds77r) or Impuruza_Source of Information (AXUtIJGHw0H.ngO89eTcOUg) as a Program Data Element dimension in the Pivot Table / analytics call - a single Indicator/Program Indicator has no built-in GROUP BY.
